subject: wow! you must have had
author: Paul_Dnap
body:
wow! you must have had really high expectations then, Paradise is fantastic and I really rather quite enjoyed Saints Row and am looking forward to the follow ups.

Anyway, for GTA IV - I hope they really do a proper "open world" experience as we now have in Burnout Paradise - in GTA:SA, yes it was a big open map but you still had a fairly linear mission structure (i.e. you could go places but there was nothing much to do until you'd got to a certain point in the narrative)
